markets.description: This market resolves Yes if the Federal Open Market Committee announces a decrease in the target federal funds rate at its December 2026 meeting, as reported by the Federal Reserve. Otherwise it resolves No.
markets.question: Will the Federal Reserve cut rates at the December 2026 meeting?

markets.description: This market resolves Yes if the National Weather Service reports at least 0.01 inches of precipitation at San Francisco International Airport on November 1, 2026. Otherwise it resolves No.
markets.question: Will it rain in San Francisco on November 1, 2026?

markets.description: This market resolves Yes if the city clerk's certified results show the 2026 ballot measure passed with more than 50% of votes cast. Otherwise it resolves No.
markets.question: Did the 2026 city ballot measure pass?

markets.description: This market resolves Yes if the BTC-USD daily close on Coinbase on December 31, 2026 is at or above $120,000. Otherwise it resolves No.
markets.question: Will BTC close above $120,000 on December 31, 2026?
